description: This file defines the StreamingActor class, an Akka actor responsible for managing streaming sessions, WebSocket configurations, and related behaviors in a streaming service component within the Eclipse Ditto project. It handles session creation, config retrieval, and metrics.

classes.name: StreamingActor
classes.description: An Akka actor managing streaming sessions and WebSocket configurations, delegating session handling, reacting to connection requests, config retrieval, and maintaining metrics within the Eclipse Ditto streaming service.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props for instantiating a StreamingActor with specified dependencies.

methods.name: supervisorStrategy
methods.description: Overrides the supervisor strategy to escalate unknown or Throwable exceptions.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handling behavior, combining config behaviors and session logic.

methods.name: createConnectAndMetricsBehavior
methods.description: Handles connection requests, WebSocket config retrieval, and session counter updates.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Updates the streaming configuration and reschedules the sampling timer.

methods.name: getUniqueChildActorName
methods.description: Generates a unique actor name for new streaming session actors based on a counter and URL-encoded suffix.

methods.name: scheduleScrapeStreamSessionsCounter
methods.description: Schedules periodic updates of the stream sessions counter.

methods.name: replyWebSocketConfig
methods.description: Replies with the current WebSocket configuration.

methods.name: updateStreamingSessionsCounter
methods.description: Updates the gauge metric for the current number of streaming sessions.
